statement: An effect, as it is activated, declares everything its resolution does: each kind of move, and where it takes cards from when that is certain (the Deck, the GY). Cards that respond to what an effect includes read that: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring, Ghost Belle & Haunted Mansion, Necrovalley.

sources.by: Claude (the reader's reading of what those cards' texts respond to)

scripts: The scripts often leave a category out: GRAVE_SPSUMMON on 69 cards that read, GRAVE_ACTION on 58, DECKDES on 22, LEAVE_GRAVE on 4, and a few others that are part of the resolution: TODECK (Herald of Pure Light's shuffle from the hand, Parametalfoes Azortless's, the Mulcharmys'), RELEASE (Nibiru, Ame no Habakiri no Mitsurugi, Mitsurugi Great Purification, EMERGENCY!), TOGRAVE (Cards of the Red Stone, Cross Porter), DESTROY (Rokket Tracer, D.D. Destroyer), EQUIP (Dragunity Dux and Legionnaire), REMOVE (Psiics), ATKCHANGE and DEFCHANGE (Nibiru, Infinity and Finity). On the eleven cards of the two decks written by hand, the script's operation info already shows the GY, so Ghost Belle responds to the same effects either way.
